description.en: Returns the handle of a character identified by a GET_HANDLE_TYPE_* constant (e.g. GET_HANDLE_TYPE_CTRL_PC for the player-controlled character).
A GET_HANDLE_TYPE_* constant identifying which character to fetch.
Optional; when true, waits for the character to be ready/loaded before returning its handle.

example.code:
// Get the player-controlled character's handle, waiting until it's ready
local hTenmaL = CMND_GET_CHARA_HANDLE(GET_HANDLE_TYPE_CTRL_PC, true);
